body.statement: Uniformly for bounded \(u,z\), \(\left|c\ell_{c,b}(u,z)-\frac12z^{\top}C(b)z\right|\le3\|z\|_\infty^2(\|u\|_\infty+\|z\|_\infty)/c\), and \(R^{\top}C(b)R\succeq\beta^2I_{K-1}\). Hence \(G(u,z)(t)\to G(u,z)(1)\) as \(t\uparrow1\) with a computable endpoint modulus.
body.justification: The projected quadratic endpoint is the fixed-positive-penalty regime after local compactification.
body.gap: The fixed-penalty quadratic law in Fang--Ridder--Xie does not prove uniform matching to all vanishing local penalties.
body.consumer: The endpoint reduction connects the path to published regret theory and removes an infinite temperature tail from numerical integration.
